name: Huang Ruohong
current_role: Executive Director and Chairman, Redco Properties Group (HKEX: 1622)
profile: Huang Ruohong (Wong Yeuk Hung, 黄若虹) founded Redco Properties, a Shenzhen-headquartered residential developer listed in Hong Kong, and is its controlling shareholder (about 40%). He has chaired the board since March 2017. The company, like many Chinese developers, has been working through a difficult property market.
interesting_fact: He became Redco's board chairman and an executive director in March 2017 in his capacity as controlling shareholder, after building the developer from its Fujian/Jiangxi roots into an HKEX-listed group.
deep_cut_fact: He holds the Hong Kong title of Justice of the Peace (JP), is a member of a national CPPCC committee and serves as vice chairman of the Hong Kong Federation of Fujian Associations.
notes: Known in HK filings as Wong Yeuk Hung. No published IR email found; check latest HKEX annual report for company secretary / IR contact. Avoid referencing the company's debt situation in outreach.

name: Yang Zhen
current_role: Founder and (per 2024 reports) actual controller of Jiajia Food Group (加加食品, SZSE: 002650); no longer chairman
profile: Yang Zhen (杨振, b. 1962, Ningxiang, Hunan) founded Jiajia soy sauce in 1996 and took it public in 2012 as China's first listed soy-sauce maker, earning the nickname 'soy sauce king'. He later stepped back from management to focus on outside investments; a cousin, Yang Xudong, now chairs the company.
interesting_fact: In 2003 he spent RMB 48m, nearly all of Jiajia's profits from its first seven years, to win CCTV's prime-time 'ad king' slot for two months; revenue hit a record RMB 500m in 2004.
deep_cut_fact: Before going into business he trained at Yiyang Normal College and worked as a Chinese-language teacher. He is credited with inventing the built-in pull-ring soy-sauce bottle cap, and he founded Jiajia in 1996 after Hunan factories turned down his offer to sell the patent for RMB 500k.
notes: Sensitive. Since 2022, Yang and his holding company have repeatedly been listed as debt defaulters, and Jiajia has been ST-flagged over guarantees he arranged. Approach with care, if at all. No personal or office contact published. Go through the Jiajia Food board secretary listed in SZSE filings.

name: Prateek Agarwal
current_role: Head of Strategic Sourcing and Planning, Macleods Pharmaceuticals; promoter-group shareholder (per 2022 DRHP)
profile: Prateek Agarwal is part of the Bawri/Agarwal family that founded Mumbai-based Macleods Pharmaceuticals, a large privately held generics maker known for affordable TB and HIV drugs. He joined the company in 2012, heads strategic sourcing and planning, and was named as a promoter selling shareholder in Macleods' 2022 IPO draft prospectus.
interesting_fact: Macleods, founded in 1989, became a pioneer in low-cost tuberculosis medicines supplied around the world.
deep_cut_fact: He has a bachelor's degree in pharmacy from the University of Mumbai. He has worked at Macleods since 1 August 2012 and is a pharmacist by training, not only a family shareholder.
notes: Low public profile. Son of Macleods chairman Banwarilal Bawri (Agarwal). Co-founder and MD Rajendra Agarwal reportedly died in Nov 2025. The IR email comes from the 2022 IPO draft; the IPO was not completed, so the address may be inactive.

name: Huang Jinlan
profile: Hurun China (2017-2021) linked Huang Jinlan (黄金兰) to Zuoyou (左右), the Shenzhen sofa and furniture maker. Public sources name Huang Huakun (黄华坤) as Zuoyou's founder and chairman, and no source found describes Huang Jinlan's role.
notes: Could not confirm this person's identity or role. The company's public face is founder/chairman Huang Huakun (https://house.huanqiu.com/article/45vap4zG0ww); outreach about Zuoyou should probably go through the company. Checking Chinese business registries for the shareholder list was outside the allowed tools.

name: Zhang Chunlin
current_role: Founder and former chairman of SafBon Water Service (Shanghai); listed as CEO of Shanghai Yingsu Environment & Technology
profile: Zhang Chunlin (张春霖) founded Shanghai-based SafBon Water Service, a water-treatment engineering and equipment company listed in Shenzhen, and chaired it from 1999 to October 2021. In 2021 he sold a 9.91% stake (about CNY 340m) to Shandong Gaochuang Construction Investment Group, which took control, and he left the company in 2022.
interesting_fact: He sold a 9.91% SafBon stake to state-backed Shandong Gaochuang Construction Investment for about CNY 340m, completed 21 June 2021, handing control of the water-treatment firm he had built since 1999 to a state-linked investor.
deep_cut_fact: He has an MBA from Antai College of Economics & Management at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
notes: Low profile since leaving SafBon. Career dates come from MarketScreener aggregator profiles. No published personal or office contact found.

name: Sharan Pasricha
current_role: Founder & President, Ennismore (Accor joint venture); Founder & CEO, Estelle Community
profile: London-based hotelier (b. 1980, Mumbai). He founded Ennismore in 2011, bought The Hoxton in Shoreditch and Gleneagles, and grew The Hoxton into an international chain. In 2021 Ennismore merged into a joint venture with Accor, which now has 16+ lifestyle brands (Mondrian, SLS, 25hours, Mama Shelter) and 180+ hotels. He also runs Estelle Community (Maison Estelle, Estelle Manor).
interesting_fact: He led the 2015 purchase of Scotland's Gleneagles from Diageo. A dozen-plus renovation projects followed, and operating profits were reported at more than £1m a week in 2018. He was made an MBE in 2022.
deep_cut_fact: While a student at Regent's College he started a London marketing agency, RUSH! Media. Before his MBA he spent three years in New Delhi as turnaround CEO of his uncle's leather-manufacturing business. In 2011 his first move as a hotelier was a bid to buy Soho House with founder Nick Jones.

public_contacts.value: https://ennismore.com/contact/ (choose 'Press'; the form routes to info@ennismore.com)

notes: Most accessible person in this lane. He gives frequent trade-press interviews (Skift, Hospitality Design) and fits an entrepreneurship podcast well. info@ennismore.com appears in the contact form's page source as the address for Press enquiries.
